template.title: The Singing Kite Adventure
template.summary: A child and a sweet pet find a humming kite and learn to share a snack together.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the [[slot_place]].
Their best friend, a soft [[slot_pet]], hopped beside them.
One sunny day, they found a bright [[slot_color]] kite fluttering.
The kite sang a gentle hum when [[slot_child]] laughed.
The hum made the kite glow a warm [[slot_light_color]].
But the kite was a little too big for the [[slot_child]]'s hands.
First, [[slot_child]] thought to toss the kite away.
Then they remembered that [[slot_pet]] liked to chase bright things.
So [[slot_child]] gently tied the kite to their backpack and walked to the [[slot_activity]].
The kite pulsed, humming a happy tune as they rode.
At the end of the ride, [[slot_child]] took a bite of [[slot_snack]] and shared it with [[slot_pet]].
Both smiled, and the kite sang a soft lullaby.
